csv_project_name: AE for Highgrove Rd & Byars Rd Intersection Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Grandview, Public Works Department is requesting the services of a consulting engineering firm to perform Engineering Design Services for Highgrove Rd and Byars Rd Intersection Improvements Project. The engineering responsibilities may include but are not limited to the following: The preparation of Conceptual plans, Preliminary plans, Contract plans and Right of Way Plans. Design services may include, right of way plans, surveying, geotechnical investigations, public involvement, environmental and historic preservation services/permits, contract documents, assisting with the bidding process, construction support/construction inspection, utility coordination/permits and traffic controls including the preparation of PS&E and final documents.
